title: Creation of a database of test subjects for the preparation of a Phase I study for the development of a new drug for stroke therapy
summary:
A database of healthy volunteers is being set up for the development of a new drug for stroke therapy. The aim is to identify potential study participants at an early stage in order to speed up recruitment for a planned Phase I study. This study will investigate the safety of the substance MJK2134025, which influences a specific mechanism in the brain and may have positive effects after a stroke.

Interested volunteers will receive detailed information on Phase I trials, their opportunities and risks. Participation includes a health check lasting around two hours with a physical examination, blood sample, ECG and urine sample.

interventions.name: Subjects interested in participating in Phase I trials will be screened to determine their eligibility for inclusion in Phase I trials.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Male healthy subjects aged 18-50 years
- BMI 20-30 kg/m2
- Weight > 70 kg
Exclusion criteria:
- Smoker (current nicotine consumption that cannot be interrupted for a period of at least 14 days)
- Illegal drug or alcohol consumption
- Individuals unable to give consent
